description: Writes a section into the open CIVIL NX model exactly as Section Designer's Write button does: VALUE/GEN, PSC/VALU or COMPOSITE-GEN with its computed properties (CIVIL keeps them as sent), in the model's units read at the time of writing, then reads it back and compares every value sent. id defaults to the model's next free section id. Refuses unconverged results. If the id is taken it writes nothing and says by what (and how many elements use it); replacing needs replaceExisting: true — DESTRUCTIVE, only with the user's agreement. Previews unless apply: true with confirmPlanHash. Before applying, show the user the drawing (section_preview) and the properties and get their go-ahead. section_write_undo reverses it. Same section input as section_preview.

apply.description: Write to CIVIL NX. Only after the user approved the preview.

confirmPlanHash.description: planHash from the approved preview; the write is refused if the plan differs.

id.description: Section id; default = next free id in the model.

replaceExisting.description: DESTRUCTIVE: overwrite the section already at id (elements using it change stiffness). Only with the user's agreement.

section.description: The section, read off the sketch. Axes: y across (positive right), z up, as seen in CIVIL's section dialog; put the origin anywhere convenient (e.g. bottom-left corner or soffit centre) — CIVIL's frame is applied on write.

merge.description: Merge touching/overlapping regions of the same part.

parts.description: One part per material, in CONSTRUCTION ORDER (part 1 = first in place, e.g. the steel or precast girder; then the deck slab). Each composite stage i = parts 1…i.

anyOf.description: A grade: concrete "C40/50" (EN 1992 Ecm, ν 0.2) or steel "S355" (210 GPa, ν 0.3).

reference.description: Composite only: the material every other part is transformed to (one part; default part 1).

regions.description: Closed areas of this material. Regions of one part that touch are merged (Union).

holes.description: Voids inside this outer outline (box cells, ducts).

anyOf.description: Vertices in order round the outline (either direction); closed automatically.

bulge.description: The edge from this vertex to the next is an arc: tan(sweep/4), positive = anticlockwise (DXF convention). 1 = semicircle.

fillet.description: Round this corner with this radius.

anyOf.description: Vertices in order round the outline (either direction); closed automatically.

bulge.description: The edge from this vertex to the next is an arc: tan(sweep/4), positive = anticlockwise (DXF convention). 1 = semicircle.

fillet.description: Round this corner with this radius.

template.description: A Section Designer template instead of regions; lengths in the section's units. Soffit on z = 0 and centreline on y = 0, moved by at. i_girder: H depth, tw web, Bt/tft top flange width/thickness, Bb/tfb bottom flange, htw/hth top haunch width (beyond the web face)/height, hbw/hbh bottom haunch. box_girder: cells 1–3, B deck width, Bw outer width across the webs at the top (under the cantilever roots), Bs soffit width, H depth, ts top slab, tb bottom slab, tw web thickness (horizontal), tc/tr cantilever thickness at tip/root, htw/hth and hbw/hbh cell haunches (top and bottom corners). Haunches default to 0.

at.description: Where the template's soffit centre goes, [y, z].

type.description: One part: general = VALUE/GEN; psc = PSC/VALU (for prestressed concrete with PSC design). Two or more parts always write COMPOSITE-GEN.

units.description: Units of every coordinate, radius and template dimension.

warpingEffect.description: CIVIL's 'Consider warping effect': also computes and writes the warping constant IW, the shear centre (YS_YC, ZS_ZC = centroid − shear centre), IP and the warping function / torsion shear coefficients at the stress points (W, CXY, CXZ). Single-material sections only; use it for thin-walled open steel sections.
